# The `ThreadingPath` Struct Reference

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/anonymous-dfajumpthreading-cpp-/threadingpath">ThreadingPath</a> is a path in the control flow of a loop that can be threaded by cloning necessary basic blocks and replacing conditional branches with unconditional ones. <a href="#details">More...</a></p>

## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/anonymous-dfajumpthreading-cpp-/threadingpath">ThreadingPath</a> is a path in the control flow of a loop that can be threaded by cloning necessary basic blocks and replacing conditional branches with unconditional ones.</p>


<p>A threading path includes a list of basic blocks, the exit state, and the block that determines the next state.</p>


<p>Definition at line 384 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/transforms/lib/transforms/scalar/dfajumpthreading-cpp">DFAJumpThreading.cpp</a>.</p>
